faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding RAG architecture, SePay payment integration, and data confidentiality.
faq.q1: How does ReplyEase AI differ from traditional rule-based chatbots?
faq.a1: Traditional chatbots rely on rigid decision trees and fail when a customer phrases something unexpectedly. ReplyEase AI leverages large language models augmented with RAG to deeply understand product literature, converse naturally, and compute dynamic VietQR payment codes tailored to each order.
faq.q2: Is SePay VietQR integration secure, and does it require bank credentials?
faq.a2: Completely secure. ReplyEase AI and SePay only monitor incoming balance fluctuation webhooks (read-only transaction alerts). We have zero access to initiate transactions or transfer funds from your account. You maintain full ownership and control of your banking.
faq.q3: What data should I prepare to train my AI assistant?
faq.a3: Simply upload existing store materials: Excel price lists, product PDFs, shipping and return policies, or your public website URL. The system automatically chunks and indexes your documents in under 3 minutes.
faq.q4: When does a human sales representative need to step in?
faq.a4: When the AI identifies strong customer frustration, questions outside the uploaded knowledge base, or an explicit request to speak with staff, ReplyEase AI automatically triggers an urgent handover alert via Telegram, Zalo, or Email with the full conversation history.
faq.q5: Can I test the platform for free before committing to a paid plan?
faq.a5: Yes. You can start immediately with our Standard Free plan (1 website, 100 AI Chat credits) with no credit card required. When your sales scale up, upgrade anytime to Pro (350,000 VND/mo for 5 domains & 500 credits) or Ultimate (850,000 VND/mo for 10 domains & 5,000 credits).
faq.q6: How long does it take to embed ReplyEase AI into an active website?
faq.a6: Approximately 5 minutes. Simply copy a single JavaScript widget snippet from your dashboard and paste it before the closing body tag. It works directly with WordPress, Shopify, Haravan, Sapo, Next.js, and custom web stacks.
